traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.desc: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 22 (5d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Life Drain.

actions.name: Necrotic Sword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Bow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: 6 (1d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a Zombie under the wight's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at a time.

traits.name: Ephemeral
traits.desc: The wisp can't wear or carry anything.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The wisp sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Shock
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d8 + 2) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Consume Life
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, one living creature the wisp can see within 5 feet that has 0 Hit Points. Failure: The target dies, and the wisp regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points.

actions.name: Vanish
actions.desc: The wisp and its light have the Invisible condition until the wisp's Concentration ends on this effect, which ends early immediately after the wisp makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.
